overlayNotes.reason: NHS Supply Chain writes this awarded supplier as 'CGM Lab' on the Digital Diagnostic Solutions framework page, which is a trading/brand style and not a legal entity, so it resolved to nothing. The framework's own contract award notice names the contractor as 'CGM' at Blegny, Belgium (NUTS BE332 - Arr. Liege), SME: Yes. The Belgian official register (Crossroads Bank for Enterprises) shows exactly one active company of that name at that seat: CGM LAB Belgium, enterprise number 0899.048.260, a public limited company at Rue Pres-Champs 25 box B, 4671 Blegny, registered since 04/07/2008, whose recorded activities are computer programming and other software publishing - consistent with a laboratory information system supplier. TWO NEAR MISSES WERE CHECKED AND RULED OUT. (1) It is NOT CompuGroup Medical bv, the CGM group's own Belgian corporate entity, which its own site gives as Brusselsesteenweg 283/10, 9230 Wetteren, BE0437432881 - a different town and a different enterprise number from the entity the award notice locates at Blegny. (2) It is NOT any of the diabetes suppliers already in the seed whose records contain the letters 'CGM': in those records CGM is the abbreviation for continuous glucose monitoring, not CompuGroup Medical, and merging on those three letters would be exactly the homonym merge rule 10 forbids. No Companies House number is recorded because this is a Belgian company and has none. Resolved 05/09/2026 during framework-coverage work on Digital Diagnostic Solutions, where it was the framework's only unresolved supplier name.
